analytics.name: Analytic 1716
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Encrypted Channel from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App writes high-entropy blob (Shannon entropy > $EntropyThreshold$) to local staging path immediately before outbound transmission — encrypted staging artifact confirms app-layer encryption occurred]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: VPN clients, enterprise secure messaging (Signal, approved messaging), MDM agent, encryption-declared apps. Derive from MDM catalog.
Default 7.0 bits Shannon entropy for staged file. Calibrate from legitimate app file baseline. Files above threshold are likely encrypted or compressed.

analytics.name: Analytic 1717
analytics.guidance: Indirect evidence of application-layer encrypted channel usage inferred through anomalous background processing and network transmission patterns following application activity, where encryption operations are not directly observable. Detection correlates background execution + network behavior + application entitlement posture to identify misuse of encrypted communication channels.

tuning.description: Correlation window between background processing and network transmission
Apps expected to use encrypted communication channels
